records.title: デザインコンセプトの作り方
records.summary: Design concepts should connect facts, user emotions, target users, and a clear direction for visual and interaction decisions.
actionable_rules: Define a concept name before UI implementation.
Connect every UI choice to user emotion and AIOS first revenue purpose.
Use Calm Revenue Command Center as the guiding concept.

records.title: デザインの基本4原則
records.summary: Proximity, alignment, repetition, and contrast create understandable screens and reduce user confusion.
actionable_rules: Align cards, headings, metrics, and buttons to shared baselines.
Limit each screen to one primary CTA.

records.title: UIデザインとは？重要性や優れたデザインの要素9つ
records.summary: Good UI keeps state visible, uses familiar patterns, supports user control, stays consistent, and makes success, warning, and failure clear.
actionable_rules: Always show current state and next action.
Use familiar controls and clear feedback.
Provide cancel, hold, and back paths.
